model_checkpoint_audit.issue: capable model but overprocessing bias at high CFG with mystical/glow prompts — version2 base without refiner is prone to artifact-heavy glow in atmospheric scenes
model_checkpoint_audit.verdict: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR — model suitable but needs tighter prompt and CFG control
model_checkpoint_audit.recommended_action: keep juggernautXL_version2 but reduce CFG to 7.0 and add explicit negative prompt artifact constraints

prompt_audit.v5_positive_prompt_issue: environment scene description (stream, altar, crystal orb, mist, blue glow) dominates over subject scale constraints — model treats scene as landscape/environment shot
prompt_audit.v5_negative_prompt_issue: missing: tiny subject, small person, far away, vast empty sky, wide landscape shot — allows environmental framing to dominate
prompt_audit.baseline_positive_prompt_issue: same environment-dominant prompt as v5; blue glow and mystical atmosphere keywords trigger overprocessed HDR output
prompt_audit.baseline_negative_prompt_issue: added artifact keywords but missing explicit anti-glow and anti-overprocessing terms
prompt_audit.v6_prompt_direction: increase subject-scale keywords, reduce atmospheric descriptors, add close portrait framing, add negative overprocessing/glow/HDR terms
prompt_audit.verdict: PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE — prompt is primary driver of composition failure and style overprocessing

sampler_scheduler_steps_cfg_audit.v5_denoise_issue: denoise=0.5 on EmptyLatentImage txt2img path is primary technical defect — produces half-denoised muddy gray output
sampler_scheduler_steps_cfg_audit.baseline_cfg_issue: cfg=8.0 with overprocessing-prone prompt can amplify artifact generation; reduce to 7.0 for v6
sampler_scheduler_steps_cfg_audit.verdict: TECHNICAL_ROOT_CAUSE_V5 — denoise=0.5 is confirmed primary defect; cfg=8.0 contributing to overprocessing in baseline

resolution_composition_audit.v5_resolution: 1344x768 — short_side=768 below project minimum 1024; wide 16:9 biases landscape framing
resolution_composition_audit.baseline_resolution: 1024x1024 — meets project minimum; square aspect better for portrait subject but prompt compensation still needed
resolution_composition_audit.v6_recommended: 1024x1024 — maintain baseline resolution; composition must be enforced via prompt not aspect ratio alone
resolution_composition_audit.verdict: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR — v5 resolution is below minimum; baseline resolution is correct but composition must come from prompt

overprocessing_style_control_audit.issue: mystical/glow/atmospheric prompt keywords trigger JuggernautXL overprocessing bias — produces HDR-like skin/fabric glow artifacts
overprocessing_style_control_audit.no_style_lora: no style LoRA anchor present in either recipe — model applies its own aesthetic interpretation causing style drift between seeds
overprocessing_style_control_audit.v6_mitigation: reduce glow/mystical/atmospheric keyword density; add explicit anti-overprocessing negative terms (overprocessed, HDR glow, overexposed skin, artificial glow, lens flare)
overprocessing_style_control_audit.verdict: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR — overprocessing/style drift is secondary cause of visual failure

workflow_graph_audit.v5_lora_node_issue: empty LoraLoader node with no active weights — adds graph complexity and potential execution overhead with zero benefit
workflow_graph_audit.v5_non_node_metadata_risk: shot_id non-node field in source workflow file — validator patches this before submit but source file remains risky
workflow_graph_audit.baseline_graph: clean 6-node graph (CheckpointLoaderSimple, EmptyLatentImage, CLIPTextEncode x2, KSampler, VAEDecode, SaveImage) — no extraneous nodes
workflow_graph_audit.v6_graph_direction: clean 6-node SDXL graph identical to baseline structure; updated prompt text; updated seed; updated cfg
workflow_graph_audit.verdict: ACCEPTABLE_BASELINE — v5 graph has overhead risks; baseline/v6 graph structure is sound

root_cause_priority: 1. PROMPT — environment-dominant composition and atmospheric keywords (primary)
2. DENOISE — v5 denoise=0.5 on txt2img path (primary technical, v5 only)
3. CFG — baseline cfg=8.0 amplifies overprocessing bias (secondary)
4. RESOLUTION — v5 below minimum (secondary, fixed in baseline and v6)
5. STYLE_CONTROL — no lora anchor, model aesthetic drift (tertiary)
6. WORKFLOW_GRAPH — v5 empty lora node overhead (minor)
v6_recipe_requirements: positive prompt: increase subject-scale, close portrait framing, reduce environment atmosphere density
negative prompt: add anti-glow, anti-overprocessing, anti-HDR, anti-tiny-subject terms
